defmodule LegacyApp.Villain.Parser do
  @moduledoc """
  Default parser for Villain.

  All blocks can be overridden by defining functions in this module
  """
  use Brando.Villain.Parser

  defp pretty_index(idx) do
    (idx + 1)
    |> Integer.to_string()
    |> String.pad_leading(2, "0")
  end

  @doc """
  Slideshow
  """
  def slideshow(%{"images" => images} = data, _) do
    default_srcset = Brando.config(Brando.Images)[:default_srcset]
    indexed_images = Enum.with_index(images)

    assigns = %{indexed_images: indexed_images, data: data, default_srcset: default_srcset}

    comp = ~H"""
    <div data-panner-container>
      <div class="inner">
        <section class="items" data-panner data-panner-loop>
          <figure
            :for={{img, idx} <- @indexed_images}
            data-panner-item
            data-orientation={Brando.Images.get_image_orientation(img)}
          >
            <.picture
              src={img}
              opts={[
                key: :xlarge,
                alt: img["title"] || "Ill.",
                width: true,
                height: true,
                placeholder: :svg,
                sizes: "auto",
                srcset: @default_srcset,
                lazyload: true,
                lightbox: @data["lightbox"] || false
              ]}
            />
            <figcaption>
              <div class="idx">
                <%= pretty_index(idx) %>
              </div>
              <div class="caption">
                <%= img["title"] %>
              </div>
            </figcaption>
          </figure>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
    """

    Phoenix.LiveViewTest.rendered_to_string(comp)
  end
end
